actions.desc: One frightened creature within 30 feet makes a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed saving throw  the creature drops to 0 hit points. On a success  the creature takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

actions.desc: The hag briefly takes on a terrifying form or reveals its true form. Each creature within 30 feet that can see the hag makes a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. A creature under the hags curse automatically fails this saving throw. On a failure, the creature is frightened until the end of its next turn. If a creatures saving throw is successful, it is immune to the hags Horrific Transformation for 24 hours.

actions.desc: An 80-foot-long  5-foot-wide lightning bolt springs from the hags extended claw. Each creature in the area makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (6d6) lightning damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

traits.desc: A creature that makes a bargain with the hag is magically cursed for 30 days. While it is cursed, the target automatically fails saving throws against the hags Scrying and Geas spells, and the hag can cast Control Weather centered on the creature.

traits.desc:
The hags innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** dancing lights, Disguise Self
- **1/Day:** Control Weather, Geas, Scrying
